attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ft_001
steps:
  - id: receive_registration
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: POST
      endpoint: /api/register
      body:
        email: "{{input.email}}"
        password: "{{input.password}}"
        fitness_goals: "{{input.fitness_goals}}"
        current_weight: "{{input.current_weight}}"
        height: "{{input.height}}"
        dietary_preferences: "{{input.dietary_preferences}}"
    output: registration_data

  - id: create_auth_account
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      action: create
      email: "{{registration_data.email}}"
      password: "{{registration_data.password}}"
    output: auth_account

  - id: validate_profile_data
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input_data:
        fitness_goals: "{{registration_data.fitness_goals}}"
        current_weight: "{{registration_data.current_weight}}"
        height: "{{registration_data.height}}"
        dietary_preferences: "{{registration_data.dietary_preferences}}"
      schema:
        required:
          - fitness_goals
          - current_weight
          - height
          - dietary_preferences
        properties:
          fitness_goals:
            type: string
          current_weight:
            type: number
          height:
            type: number
          dietary_preferences:
            type: string
    output: validation_result

  - id: create_user_profile
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: user_profiles
      operation: insert
      record:
        auth_uid: "{{auth_account.uid}}"
        email: "{{registration_data.email}}"
        fitness_goals: "{{registration_data.fitness_goals}}"
        current_weight: "{{registration_data.current_weight}}"
        height: "{{registration_data.height}}"
        dietary_preferences: "{{registration_data.dietary_preferences}}"
    output: user_profile

  - id: log_registration_event
    op: log_audit
    params:
      event: user_registration
      user_id: "{{auth_account.uid}}"
      details:
        email: "{{registration_data.email}}"
        profile_id: "{{user_profile.id}}"
        timestamp: "{{now}}"
    output: audit_log_entry
